description: Approved security and governance configuration for AI agent repositories. Repository controls follow the ISD EAG golden repository; agent controls add identity, model, tool, telemetry and evaluation requirements that ADCM can verify.

rules.title: No committed secrets
rules.rationale: Secrets in source are exposed to every reader and every fork, and survive in git history.
rules.remediation: Remove the secret, rotate it, and load it at runtime from Key Vault through a managed identity.

rules.title: Secret scanning in CI
rules.rationale: Secret scanning on every push and pull request stops credentials before they reach the default branch.
rules.remediation: Add the golden repo secret-scan workflow (gitleaks, SHA-pinned) and make it a required check.

rules.title: Actions pinned to commit SHAs
rules.rationale: Tags are mutable; a compromised action tag runs attacker code with the workflow token.
rules.remediation: Pin every third-party action to a full 40-character commit SHA and let Dependabot update it.

rules.title: Least-privilege workflow tokens
rules.rationale: Without an explicit permissions block the GITHUB_TOKEN may get write access to the repository.
rules.remediation: Add a top-level 'permissions: contents: read' to every workflow and grant writes per job only.

rules.title: OIDC federation instead of long-lived cloud secrets
rules.rationale: Stored cloud credentials are long-lived and shared; workload identity federation issues short-lived tokens per run.
rules.remediation: Use azure/login with client-id, tenant-id and subscription-id (OIDC) and a federated credential on the deployment identity.

rules.title: Keyless model and service authentication
rules.rationale: API keys cannot be attributed to an agent, are hard to rotate, and bypass Conditional Access and identity governance.
rules.remediation: Authenticate with DefaultAzureCredential or the agent's Entra Agent ID, and disable local (key) auth on the resource.

rules.title: No shadow AI proxy
rules.rationale: Self-hosted model proxies bypass the approved AI gateway, its content safety, identity and inventory, and have been targeted by supply-chain attacks.
rules.remediation: Call models through the Foundry project or the approved API Management AI gateway instead of an embedded proxy.

rules.title: Runs as an Entra Agent ID
rules.rationale: Agent identities are governable as agents: sponsor, lifecycle, Conditional Access and kill switch.
rules.remediation: Create an agent identity from an approved blueprint and declare identity.type: entra_agent_id with its blueprint_id.

rules.title: Approved model
rules.rationale: Approved models have completed security, privacy and responsible-AI review.
rules.remediation: Use a model deployment from the approved list, or request review of the new model.

rules.title: Content safety enabled
rules.rationale: Content filters and prompt-shield protections reduce jailbreak and harmful-output risk.
rules.remediation: Attach a content filter (RAI) policy to the deployment and declare model.content_safety.enabled: true.

rules.title: Tool allow-list and human approval for writes
rules.rationale: Unvetted tools and MCP servers extend the agent's reach; write actions need a human in the loop.
rules.remediation: Use approved tool types and MCP hosts only, and set approval: required on every write-capable tool.

rules.title: Code scanning (CodeQL)
rules.rationale: Static analysis finds injection and unsafe deserialisation before release.
rules.remediation: Add the golden repo CodeQL workflow.

rules.title: Dependabot updates
rules.rationale: Automated update PRs keep dependencies and pinned action SHAs patched.
rules.remediation: Add .github/dependabot.yml for your package ecosystem and github-actions.

rules.title: Locked dependencies
rules.rationale: Lockfiles make builds reproducible and stop silent upgrades to compromised versions.
rules.remediation: Commit uv.lock, poetry.lock, hash-pinned requirements or package-lock.json.

rules.title: SBOM produced in CI
rules.rationale: A software bill of materials and provenance attestation let you answer 'are we affected?' quickly.
rules.remediation: Add the golden repo SBOM workflow.

rules.title: Signed head commit
rules.rationale: Verified signatures tie default-branch history to an authenticated author.
rules.remediation: Sign commits (SSH or GPG) and enable 'Require signed commits' in the branch ruleset.

rules.title: Deployed agent matches the declared configuration
rules.rationale: Changes made directly in the portal bypass review: a different model, extra tools or another identity.
rules.remediation: Redeploy from the repository, or update the manifest through a reviewed pull request.

rules.title: Agent manifest
rules.rationale: The manifest declares owner, sponsor, data classification, identity, model, tools and deployments so they can be verified.
rules.remediation: Add adcm-agent.yaml from the golden baseline template and fill in every field.

rules.title: Code owners
rules.rationale: Code owners make review responsibility explicit and enforceable.
rules.remediation: Add .github/CODEOWNERS and require code owner review.

rules.title: Security policy
rules.rationale: Reporters need a private channel for vulnerabilities.
rules.remediation: Add SECURITY.md from the golden repo.

rules.title: Pull request template
rules.rationale: A template prompts authors for risk, testing and data-handling evidence.
rules.remediation: Add .github/pull_request_template.md from the golden repo.

rules.title: Protected default branch
rules.rationale: Reviews and required checks only gate changes when the branch enforces them.
rules.remediation: Apply the golden ruleset: 1 approval, code owner review, required 'guardrails' check, signed commits, no force push or deletion.

rules.title: Approved agent SDK at a supported version
rules.rationale: Supported SDKs carry identity, tracing and security fixes that older or unofficial clients lack.
rules.remediation: Depend on azure-ai-projects, azure-ai-agents or Microsoft Agent Framework at or above the minimum version.

rules.title: Telemetry enabled
rules.rationale: Traces make agent behaviour observable for investigation, evaluation and kill-switch decisions.
rules.remediation: Add azure-monitor-opentelemetry and call configure_azure_monitor() at startup.

rules.title: Evaluations run in CI
rules.rationale: Quality and safety evaluations catch regressions before deployment.
rules.remediation: Add datasets under evals/ and run them from a workflow on pull requests.

rules.title: Guardrails gate in CI
rules.rationale: Running the same baseline check on every pull request stops drift before merge.
rules.remediation: Add the adcm-guardrails action from the golden baseline repository as a required 'guardrails' check.

rules.title: Current baseline version
rules.rationale: Pinning the baseline makes upgrades deliberate; falling behind means missing newer controls.
rules.remediation: Review the baseline changelog and update baseline_version in adcm-agent.yaml.
